mapper.select: SELECT G.user_id AS protege_id, U.user_name AS protege_name, G.relation FROM tb_guardian G JOIN tb_user U ON U.user_id = G.user_id WHERE G.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND G.status = 'APPROVED' AND U.user_type = 'PROTECTED' ORDER BY G.guardian_seq

INSERT INTO tb_settings ( user_id, total_distance, crosswalk_num, traffic_light, IOT_light, vehicle_entryway, block_ratio, tts_speed, sound_output, crosswalk_output, blinker_output, access_output, facility_output, path_end_comment, current_times, location_information, reg_user_id, reg_date ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{totalDistance}, #{crosswalkNum}, #{trafficLight}, #{iotLight}, #{vehicleEntryway}, #{blockRatio}, #{ttsSpeed}, #{soundOutput}, #{crosswalkOutput}, #{blinkerOutput}, #{accessOutput}, #{facilityOutput}, #{pathEndComment}, #{currentTimes}, #{locationInformation}, #{userId}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_distance = #{totalDistance}, crosswalk_num = #{crosswalkNum}, traffic_light = #{trafficLight}, IOT_light = #{iotLight}, vehicle_entryway = #{vehicleEntryway}, block_ratio = #{blockRatio}, tts_speed = #{ttsSpeed}, sound_output = #{soundOutput}, crosswalk_output = #{crosswalkOutput}, blinker_output = #{blinkerOutput}, access_output = #{accessOutput}, facility_output = #{facilityOutput}, path_end_comment = #{pathEndComment}, current_times = #{currentTimes}, location_information= #{locationInformation}, last_chg_user_id = #{userId}, last_chg_date = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT A.user_id, A.user_name, A.zipcode, A.addr, A.addr_detail, A.user_email, A.phone_no, A.wifi_id AS wifiId, A.wifi_password AS wifiPassword, B.total_distance, B.crosswalk_num, B.traffic_light, B.IOT_light, B.vehicle_entryway, B.rotation, B.block_ratio, B.tts_speed, B.sound_output, B.crosswalk_output, B.blinker_output, B.access_output, B.facility_output, B.path_end_comment, B.current_times, B.location_information FROM vw_user_sw A LEFT JOIN tb_settings B ON A.user_id = B.user_id WHERE A.user_id = #{userId}
